invariants.rationale: The method requires a Class<T> parameter as input, and code that calls resources.get(type) assumes type is not null.
If result is not null, then ObjectMap.size is non-negative.
If result is not null, its keys() iterator must also be non-null.
If result is not null, its values() collection must also be non-null.
ObjectMap's notEmpty() is typically true iff its size is greater than zero; holds for all return values.
